A food item which restores {{Energy||13-}} {{Energy||24}} and applies the beer thirst buff when consumed.  It can be made in the [[oven]].  The quality is dependent on the ingredients used as well as any [[perks]] or [[sermons]] that might be active.  Higher quality {{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} have a larger restorative effect when consumed.  For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]]. {{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can also be purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].

==Effect==

On use, toast with onions will apply the beer thirst buff for a duration of 2 minutes. The buff increases energy restoration from [[a mug of beer|beer]] by 33%.
